NDT software in Odessa: built for Permian Basin inspection work

NDT software for an Odessa inspection company has to work where the Permian Basin work actually happens: on lease roads without signal, at tank batteries and compressor stations hours from the yard, on pipeline spreads with RT crews working long days, and in tubular yards where volume is high and turnaround is tight. The Atlantis ERP solution puts technicians, certificates, instruments, dispatch, reports, quotes and invoices in one system configured for that reality.

Odessa and Midland sit at the centre of the most active oil field in the United States. ExxonMobil, Chevron, Occidental, ConocoPhillips, EOG and Midland-based Diamondback Energy all run large Permian operations. Midstream companies such as Energy Transfer, Targa, Enterprise and Kinder Morgan operate gathering systems, gas processing plants and long-haul takeaway pipelines, including lines like the Permian Highway and Gulf Coast Express that carry gas toward the coast. That footprint creates a constant demand for weld radiography and UT on new construction, UT thickness surveys and MFL on existing lines and tanks, hardness and PMI on fittings and valves, holiday testing on coated pipe, and inspection of oil country tubular goods and drill pipe.

Pipeline safety answers to PHMSA and the Railroad Commission of Texas. Radiography companies carry licences from the Texas Department of State Health Services, and sources move by road under transport rules. Odessa NDT contractors range from one-truck owner-operators to firms running dozens of crews, and most share the same headaches: people spread across a huge area, equipment beaten up by heat and dust, and paperwork that falls behind the work.

ERP for NDT companies in Odessa: the direct answer

An ERP for NDT companies in Odessa should keep field crews, trucks, sources, instruments and certificates in order while the office bills every day of work, including standby and per diems. The Atlantis NDT ERP connects all of those to each job, with an offline field app for places where there is no signal.

The Permian failure modes are familiar. A crew rolls out at 4am with a technician whose RT card lapsed last week. A thickness gauge that should have gone to the lab is still in a truck. Reports from a gathering line job are on paper in a cab and do not reach the office for days, so the invoice goes out late and short. The source truck's transport licence expires without anyone noticing. The Atlantis ERP catches these: certificate status is computed automatically with 90-day warnings, out-of-calibration equipment triggers a warning when assigned, reports sync from the field app, and fleet records hold transport licence expiry.

A generic business ERP does not model any of that, and spreadsheets depend on one person remembering. The Atlantis ERP builds the NDT structure in, and configures the rest during implementation. See the ERP apps overview.

Crew dispatch software for the Permian Basin

Crew dispatch in the Atlantis ERP runs every job as a team assignment moving from planned to dispatched, in field, submitted and closed, with site GPS coordinates and mobilisation and demobilisation dates. Double-booking of technicians and equipment serial numbers is blocked.

Site GPS coordinates matter more in the Permian than almost anywhere. A pad location or tank battery on a lease road does not have a street address, and a new technician needs exact coordinates to find it. The availability calendar records assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable days and blocks overlaps, which prevents the common Permian problem of a hand being promised to two operators on the same day. Each technician shows current assignment, utilisation and next available date, so when a midstream company calls for an extra RT crew on a pipeline spread, you know who can go.

When an instrument is assigned to a job, the ERP warns if it is out of calibration. The Fleet app records vehicle purpose, whether it can carry radioactive sources, transport licence number and expiry, and assignment to project and driver with dates and mileage, which gives you mileage records per job and a check on source vehicle paperwork. Calendar, kanban and list views let the dispatcher see the week at a glance. More on team assignments.

NDT reporting software that works without signal

The NDT reports app provides 17 method-specific report types, including RT, UT, UT thickness, MFL, PAUT, TOFD, MT, PT, VT, hardness, PMI, holiday/coating and computed radiography, each with its own numbering sequence. The offline field app lets technicians complete reports without signal and sync later.

On a Permian pipeline spread, the RT report captures source, technique, IQI type and placement, and weld lines carry defect type and orientation with an overall result of acceptable, not acceptable or acceptable with remarks. UT thickness reports record readings by direction for a tank shell or a section of gathering line. MFL reports record scan mode and item lines. Hardness and PMI reports cover fittings, valves and repairs. Holiday reports cover coated pipe going into the ditch. Each report references work order, request, WPS, contract, drawing numbers, procedure and standard.

In the field app a technician picks the method, captures photos, signs on screen and previews the PDF, and drafts and photos are stored on the device until the truck gets back to coverage in town. Reports then move through review and approval with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures, and third-party inspector signatures where the operator requires them. Versioned templates in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML reproduce each operator's preferred format, and Excel templates fill automatically from mapped fields. The REST API for field devices also handles jobs assigned to a technician and equipment issued to them. For operators who want results on a 3D model, see Atlantis Digital Twins.

Technician certification tracking software for Permian crews

Technician certification tracking in the Atlantis ERP records scheme, level, method, certifying body, issue, expiry and renewal dates for each certificate and computes status automatically as active, expiring soon (90 days), expired or revoked. Daily checks create warning tasks 90 days out, and email alerts go to whoever you choose.

Permian contractors have high turnover and hire fast when activity picks up. New hands arrive with trainee status and OJT hours that need to be logged, while experienced technicians carry multiple method certifications. The certificate record holds OJT hours, training hours, exam results and attachments, and examination sheets store general, specific and practical scores. Certificate templates per scheme set validity in months, whether a vision test or exam is required, and minimum OJT and training hours, which keeps your written practice applied consistently as you grow.

For radiography, the employee NDT profile records radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry, and vision tests are tracked with their own expiry. Timesheets warn if a technician's certificate is not valid, so a lapsed card gets flagged even on a job that was dispatched in a hurry. Company certifications and operator approvals have their own alert days. See the certificates app.

Calibration management software for equipment that lives in trucks

Calibration management in the Atlantis ERP tracks every instrument and probe by serial number with calibration frequency, status and next due date, and keeps a certificate register with lab accreditation number, validity status, PDF and expiry alerts. Assigning an out-of-calibration instrument to a job triggers a warning.

Permian equipment takes a beating. Thickness gauges, flaw detectors, MFL scanners, hardness testers, PMI analysers, survey meters and holiday detectors ride around in trucks through heat and dust. The maintenance log records preventive, corrective, repair, cleaning, firmware update and probe replacement work with condition before and after. The issue and return workflow records condition at checkout and return with supervisor and manager approval, so damage is traced to a job rather than discovered weeks later. Reservations prevent clashes and movements are logged.

Consumables such as couplant, penetrant, developer, film-related supplies and PPE carry reorder levels and low-stock flags, which matters when the nearest supplier is not next door. If you rent instruments to other contractors, rental rates can be recorded. Purchase records separate OEMs, dealers and calibration labs, with accreditation details and expiry. See asset management.

Procedures for operator and pipeline work

The procedures app keeps one register of procedures with document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard, acceptance criteria and text or file. Workflow runs draft, submitted, reviewed, approved and published, and approved revisions are locked.

Permian operators and pipeline companies frequently require contractor procedures to be submitted and approved before work, and different operators want different acceptance criteria referenced. Keeping a separate approved RT procedure for each pipeline customer, plus UT thickness, MFL and hardness procedures, is manageable when every revision is snapshotted and approval history is recorded. Email notifications and reminders keep your Level III from becoming the bottleneck while they are out in the field. The AI-assisted first draft helps start a new procedure, and the Level III reviews and approves it. Procedure and WPS references flow into project tasks and reports.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Odessa contractors

Quotes, timesheets, expenses and invoices in the Atlantis ERP all belong to the same job, so everything done in the field reaches the invoice. Quotes carry job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, and accepted quotes convert to sales orders.

Permian billing lives and dies on detail. Timesheets record work type (inspection, travel, standby, setup), method, billable flag, rate multiplier, site, client and equipment serial, with approval, so travel to a remote pad, standby while a pipeline crew finishes a weld, and overtime multipliers are all captured. Expenses record per diems, lodging and field costs that can be re-billed to the job. Invoices carry project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector, with subtotals for labour, equipment and consumables, and lines show cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician, rate type and days or hours. Many operators use supplier portals; invoice layouts and the data you send are configured during implementation.

The financial dashboard shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA, outstanding invoices, bills and expenses over 12 months, which matters in a market that swings with oil prices. See invoicing.

Inspection management software: CRM, dashboards and integrations

Inspection management software for an Odessa firm should show the owner what is at risk before it becomes a problem on a location. KPI dashboards show calibration due and overdue, certificates expiring and expired, and issued equipment overdue for return, next to the financial dashboard.

The CRM records service line, lead source, NDT service type, industry sector, site country and estimated technicians and days, with a 0 to 100 NDT lead score. That helps track operators, midstream companies, pipeline construction contractors and fabrication shops across Midland, Ector, Reeves, Loving and nearby counties. Leads can be imported by CSV, followed up with AI-personalised emails and drip sequences, and business cards from local oilfield shows turned into leads in one click.

The Atlantis ERP has an open REST API and integrates with SAP, Maximo, NetSuite, QuickBooks or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation.

Affordable customizable ERP for inspection companies in Odessa

The Atlantis ERP is affordable, accessible and fully customizable, and pricing is quote on request, based on the apps and configuration you need. Atlantis NDT, founded by an ASNT NDT Level III, carries out implementation. We also provide API 510, 570 and 653 inspection services separately from the software.

An Odessa rollout usually starts with technicians, certificates and radiation safety records, then instruments and source vehicles, then the offline field app on crew phones and tablets, because that is where the Permian loses time. Report templates are matched to each operator's format, and Texas taxes and invoice layouts are configured. Office staff are trained on dispatch, timesheets and invoicing. If you train new hands, the eLearning app and the Practical NDT 3D simulator help; Atlantis offers ASNT SNT-TC-1A based NDT training. Book an Odessa ERP demo.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best NDT software for an Odessa or Midland contractor?

Software that works offline, tracks certificates and calibration automatically, and bills travel, standby and per diems. The Atlantis ERP does all of these in one system.

Does the field app really work without signal?

Yes. Drafts and photos are stored on the device and synced when coverage returns, with method picker, photo capture, on-screen signature and PDF preview.

Can it track radiography crew requirements?

Yes. It records radiation safety training, radiation badge number, medical fitness expiry, vision tests and certificates, and Fleet records source-capable vehicles and transport licences.

Is it suitable for a small NDT company with a few trucks?

Yes. Start with certificates, asset management, team assignments and NDT reports. It is affordable, with pricing quote on request.

Does the ERP calculate inspection intervals for tanks or pipelines?

No. The ERP manages people, equipment, jobs, reports and billing. Inspection services for tanks, piping and vessels are offered separately.

How do we get started?

Tell us your methods, crew count and main operators, and we will set up a demo on your data. Get started.
